title: Dog Night, 2001 · before
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The night before two years: the alley behind the Lanes walked as always, and Wood checking the sign's letters one by one, the way he'll check them for twenty years. All lit. He counts anyway.

panels.composition: The alley at night, the sign lit above, WOOD and BARNABY walking.
